name: Release v0.9.12
body:
## Snow CLI v0.9.12

### What's New

- Reliable background processes: the background panel now only registers commands actually moved to the background with Ctrl+B, so ordinary foreground commands no longer pollute the list or leave the busy indicator stuck. A 5-second PID liveness self-check marks zombie `running` entries as completed, completed entries are cleaned up automatically after 60 seconds, and the process id is captured synchronously so `close`/`error` events always update the final status. A delayed Ctrl+B request can no longer background the next unrelated command
- Structured, diagnosable logging: the logger now writes structured entries with hierarchical namespaces (`mcp.catalog`, `session.compressor`, ...), session/task/trace context, operation timings and normalized error objects, and supports a ring-buffer memory sink that never writes ANSI escape codes into the TUI. Silent `catch` blocks across core modules (agents, MCP tools, SSH/SSE, sessions/tasks/teams, plugins, UI and CLI shutdown) now emit contextual debug logs, making previously invisible failures traceable without changing user-visible behavior
- Unified storage and sandbox isolation: global paths under `~/.snow` (logs, SSE daemons, sessions, ...) now resolve through a single Snow context, and `SNOW_CONFIG_DIR` fully isolates global storage so test or multi-environment runs never touch the real home directory. Environment variables are read through a typed whitelist with safe boolean/integer/path parsing, and cache invalidation is decoupled through a registry that breaks circular dependency chains
- Engineering governance: added Biome formatting/lint configuration, knip unused-code analysis, a test gate runner with `fast` / `core` / `session` / `mcp` / `theme` profiles, dependency-cycle detection, cross-verification audit and probe-metrics scripts

### Installation
```bash
npm install -g snow-ai
```

### Usage
```bash
snow
```
### Update
```bash
snow --update
```
